definitions.explanation: inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: You become more prone to arthritis as you age.

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧ (joint) + {炎|えん} (inflammation). A medical term that follows the common Japanese pattern of body part + {炎|えん} for inflammatory conditions.

TYPES:
- {変形性|へんけいせい}{関節症|かんせつしょう}: osteoarthritis
- ⟦{関節|かんせつ}→関節：09793_kansetsu⟧リウマチ: rheumatoid arthritis
- {痛風|つうふう}: gout (also causes joint inflammation)

SYMPTOMS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧: pain
- {腫|は}れ: swelling
- こわばり: stiffness

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to develop arthritis
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧: arthritis treatment
- {関節炎|かんせつえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: arthritis worsens

COMMON PATTERNS:
The suffix {炎|えん} is productive in medical terms: ⟦{肺炎|はいえん}→肺炎：08443_haien⟧ (pneumonia), ⟦{胃炎|いえん}→胃炎：25491_ien⟧ (gastritis), ⟦{皮膚炎|ひふえん}→皮膚炎：23596_hifuen⟧ (dermatitis).
